rule: ST_PLAN Amendment 47 item 3: contrast pairs, the V_const source for C_spec2025
construction: subagent-written (claude-opus-5-5) from the principles list; 5 per non-hard-constraint principle (k 0-1 plain, 2-3 professional, 4 by position); DATASET_GUIDELINES sections 1 and 5 (section 13's procedure)
excluded: hard-constraint principles SPEC25-P19, SPEC25-P20, SPEC25-P21, SPEC25-P22, SPEC25-P24, SPEC25-P26, SPEC25-P28, SPEC25-P29, SPEC25-P31, SPEC25-P33, SPEC25-P35
split: 80/20: one pair of each principle's five held out, seeded

handcheck.drawn: 17 by a seeded draw (20261025|C_spec2025|handcheck) plus k=0 of SPEC25-P01, P06 and P54 (the writer's flagged compliance principles)

notes.SPEC25-P53/professional/3: the neutral is awkward (the date left in bold when printed)
notes.SPEC25-P06/plain/0: the neutral still honors the user's request, without the conflict: part of the principle remains (the compliance residue the writer flagged; SPEC25-P10/professional/3 borderline the same way)
